purpose: Paila Pilates Kathmandu v14 quantity-based fit-out schedule research; no task durations are claimed by these norms
interpretation: DWRI explicitly states m-day (person-day). DUDBC civil tables use head/count (sankhya) as rate-analysis labour inputs; these become wage-days when multiplied by the applicable daily labour wage. Neither source establishes an 8-hour site shift or a guaranteed elapsed duration.

For each role, workload = measured quantity / source basis quantity * role input. With a constant crew, active duration is at least the maximum workload/available-workers across required roles. Round to site workdays, observe trade dependencies, and do not allocate one worker to concurrent rows.

Rates describe the stated assembly. Applying a nearby norm to different materials, joinery complexity, prefabrication method, BOQ measurement basis, access, or modern tools is an explicit planning assumption.
Procurement, approvals, shop fabrication, delivery, drying, curing, inspections, leak tests, and commissioning require separate activities or readiness gates; labour inputs alone do not capture them.

Where source scopes already include making good/painting, do not count that work twice under another allowance. Electrical fixture mounting, socket mounting, and full point wiring are different tasks.

verified_norm_templates.caveat: Ceiling note adds 25% helper labour; plaster curing/dryness is a separate readiness condition. For isolated repairs allow setup and access losses.

verified_norm_templates.scope: 2mm plain white putty plaster to wall and ceiling
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Does not establish the number of coats in the selected commercial paint system or elapsed drying time.

verified_norm_templates.scope: Two coats plastic emulsion paint excluding primer
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Combined value uses I17 putty once plus J5 primer once plus J19 two coats. Product requirements can include additional basecoats, putty passes, sanding or a third dark-colour coat. Legacy rate-analysis inputs may be conservative relative to current roller work.

verified_norm_templates.scope: 38x75mm timber framing at 0.61x0.915m modules, 3mm commercial plywood both sides, timber battens at joints
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Only an analogue for a different frame/board partition. Not a cabinet-frontage or cement-board norm. Do not multiply the elevation area by two again.

verified_norm_templates.scope: 50x75mm timber framing at 0.60x0.90m modules with 3mm commercial plywood false ceiling
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Gypsum ceiling cannot inherit this coefficient without an explicit adapted-method assumption. DUDBC N10/N11 gypsum ceilings have no separate labour coefficient.

verified_norm_templates.scope: 12mm decorative prelaminated particleboard fitted on aluminium frame
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Useful assembly-level analogue for simple framed decorative panels. PVC slats, WPC, battens, curved work, profiles, glue and complex cutouts need their own declared adjustment.

verified_norm_templates.scope: PVC tiles with rubber-based adhesive including rolling
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Not a direct SPC click-floor or carpet norm. Only an overt proxy if flooring quantity is measured. Substrate repairs, levelling and moisture tests are separate.

verified_norm_templates.scope: 15mm marble tiles on 12.5mm 1:3 mortar to stair treads, skirting, walls and columns including rubbing and polishing
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Conservative traditional mortar-and-polish scope. Not an exact coefficient for prepolished large slabs, adhesive cladding or mechanically anchored stone. Use declared adaptation, not silent substitution.

verified_norm_templates.scope: Make and install iron rolling shutter including painting and labour
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Fabrication-plus-installation total, not site fixing alone. No shop/site split given. Modern factory-supplied shutter needs an explicit vendor-based schedule.

verified_norm_templates.scope: Mount and connect lighting fixture per drawing
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Simple scope includes dome/wall/hanging/spot/ceiling/bulkhead lights, wall fan and small chandelier. Complex includes chained tubes and larger chandelier. Does not replace full route/point-wiring work. For a few scattered fixtures use minimum mobilisation/setup rather than sub-hour task duration.

verified_norm_templates.scope: Provide/fix concealed electrical sockets and connect to electricity
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Socket mounting/connection only, distinguish from a complete power-circuit route.

verified_norm_templates.scope: Concealed light-circuit point wiring in an existing building, grooves, HD polythene pipe, hooks/nails, making good with cement-sand mortar and paint, switch and ceiling rose
verified_norm_templates.caveat: Route length, point count, circuit sizing and actual concealed-vs-surface method are required before applying. Do not infer point quantity from lump-sum electrical cost or from floor area. New-construction wiring is a different 23.20 norm.
Legacy rate-analysis input; substrate and selected coating system must match. Separate from J19 two-coat emulsion norm.

source_backed_readiness_lags.condition: New masonry before Royale paint system
source_backed_readiness_lags.caveat: Use only for new masonry. Existing dry walls do not automatically inherit this wait. Generic India Royale PIS states 28 days, so Nepal selected-product/substrate advice controls; do not silently use the shorter generic value.
Quoted at 25C and 50% RH; longer for adverse site conditions. Two light-colour coats, three for dark shades recommended. Full system can require undercoat before and after putty.

source_backed_readiness_lags.condition: Air-drying drywall compound before recoat or sanding
source_backed_readiness_lags.value: Dry thoroughly, up to24 hours depending on temperature/humidity
source_backed_readiness_lags.caveat: Use as coat-to-coat readiness gate, not labour time. Setting compounds and selected local product may have different waits.
Manufacturer example, not universal SPC instruction. Floors must be dry, smooth, clean, enclosed, and free of other trades; selected floor instructions control.

source_backed_readiness_lags.value: Wall grouting12h, floor grouting24h, approximate ready-for-use14days
source_backed_readiness_lags.caveat: Optional indexed-primary-source example; exact adhesive, substrate, load and weather determine actual wait. Do not turn14days into generic tile productivity.

unsupported_fitout_work.gypsum_and_cement_board: DUDBC N10/N11 gypsum ceilings and N15/N16 gypsum partitions/wall panels (p54) are supplied-and-installed composite items with blank labour columns. No direct labour coefficient for the actual gypsum/cement-board fit-out was established. Keep editable planning assumptions for framing/boarding and separate drying gates for joint finishing.
unsupported_fitout_work.aluminium_glazing_mirrors: DUDBC N17/N18 aluminium partitions(p55) and several prefabricated doors/windows are composite supply-and-install items. A 6mm mirror mention in G3(p21) belongs to a timber-framed shutter assembly and is NOT a freestanding studio wall-mirror installation norm. Do not reuse it for14m2 mirrors.
unsupported_fitout_work.custom_joinery: No exact primary norm established for BOQ-frontage-area plywood/laminate cabinets, open shelves, shoe racks or curved reception desk. DUDBC timber+ply panel norms provide observed assembly context only; frontage area omits cabinet depth, shelves, drawers, hardware, edge finishing and cutting complexity. Split shop fabrication/lamination, delivery and site setting; retain frontage measurement plus an editable complexity input, not invented board area.
unsupported_fitout_work.curtains_blinds: No primary labour productivity norm established; fabric area is different from track length and from sewing effort. Separate measured track fixing, off-site stitching/procurement, hanging and adjustment.
unsupported_fitout_work.sink_and_plumbing_fixtures: No verified primary Nepal fixture-labour table established within this bounded review. One sink requires a small-installation allowance plus connected pipework scope and leak test, with the allowance clearly labelled.
unsupported_fitout_work.split_AC: No verified labour productivity norm established here for six split-AC installations. Use vendor plan for mounting, line lengths, condensate routing, vacuum/leak test, electrical readiness and commissioning, with line-length assumptions visible.
unsupported_fitout_work.flooring_and_general_electrical_allowanc: Unmeasured allowances remain unmeasured; do not fabricate m2, route lengths or point counts from the allowance amount. Show provisional schedule bars pending measure and method confirmation.

schedule_logic_notes: Survey and freeze dimensions/details before custom fabrication; mirror and glazing dimensions after supporting finishes are established.
Order long-lead boards, hardware, mirrors, AC equipment and curtain fabric early; shop fabrication may overlap rough-in if dimensions are fixed.
Rough electrical, AC drain/refrigerant routes, plumbing, and supports precede board closure; inspect/test concealed work before closing.
Ceiling/partition boards, joint finishing, putty/sanding and paint undercoats precede sensitive floor finishes and exposed soft furnishings.
Sequence specialist installation by zone and crew, then final coat/touchups, fixture fit-off, leak/electrical/AC tests, snagging and cleaning. Protect finished areas.
For adjacent wet/dry trade handoffs, test readiness instead of assuming all waits are fulfilled because crew work ended.
